command:
python3 clean_data.py && echo "--- cleaned_data.csv ---" && cat cleaned_data.csv && python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv, re
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("cleaned_data.csv")))
assert len(rows) == 11, f"expected 11 rows, got {len(rows)}"
assert all(re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", r["signup_date"]) for r in rows), "non-ISO date found"
assert all(r["age"].isdigit() and 0 <= int(r["age"]) <= 120 for r in rows), "bad age found"
assert all(v == v.strip() and v == v.title() or k in ("email",) for r in rows for k, v in r.items() if k != "email"), "whitespace/casing issue"
assert not any(v != v.strip() for r in rows for v in r.values()), "stray whitespace found"
emails = [r["email"] for r in rows if r["email"]]
assert len(set(emails)) == len(emails), "duplicate email found"
print("VERIFICATION PASSED: 11 rows, ISO dates, valid ages, no whitespace, no dupes")
EOF
